metadata.title: Serum 2.0.21 Target Reconciliation Matrix
metadata.purpose: Bidirectional mapping between frozen semantic records and actual controllable targets
metadata.phase: Phase 2: Target Reconciliation (Extract → Normalize → Reconcile → Gap Analysis → Families)
metadata.discipline: No UI probing. Reconciliation only using frozen Phase 1 evidence and existing target definitions.

reconciliation_schema.semantic_id: Frozen semantic identifier from inventory (e.g., OSC1.ENABLE, FILTER1.CUTOFF, ENV1.ATTACK)
reconciliation_schema.target_ids: Array of existing targets that implement this semantic (may be empty if no target exists yet)
reconciliation_schema.mapping_class: EXACT (1:1), ONE_TO_MANY (semantic maps to multiple targets), MANY_TO_ONE (multiple semantics share target), NO_TARGET (semantic has no target), UNKNOWN (ambiguous)
reconciliation_schema.target_source: VST3_PARAMETER, UI_ACTION, STRUCTURAL_OPERATION, RESOURCE_OPERATION, MATRIX_ROUTE, OTHER
reconciliation_schema.representation_family: Behavioral grouping (e.g., all BOOLEAN read/write/persist share family; all ENUM variants in another family)
reconciliation_schema.operation_status: IMPLEMENTED (full semantic→target→operation coverage), DISCOVERED_NOT_IMPLEMENTED (target exists, operation missing), UNPROVEN (no behavioral evidence), NOT_APPLICABLE (structural only, not runtime-controllable)
reconciliation_schema.evidence_refs: References to Phase 1 closure ledgers where this semantic was verified
reconciliation_schema.status: VERIFIED (exact mapping confirmed), AMBIGUOUS (multiple possibilities), ORPHAN (target with no semantic), INCOMPLETE (partial mapping)

summary_metrics.representation_families_provisional: To be derived from behavior, not VST3 naming

reconciliation_rows_sample.label: Enable
reconciliation_rows_sample.notes: Direct 1:1 mapping. Semantic Enable observed in UI, target defined in targets.py

reconciliation_rows_sample.label: Cutoff
reconciliation_rows_sample.notes: CONFLICT: Same target 'Filter.Cutoff' used for both FILTER1 and FILTER2. Targets.py uses generic 'Filter.Cutoff', targets.py ALSO has 'Filter2.Cutoff'. Requires disambiguation: is 'Filter.Cutoff' actually FILTER1-specific or is it a shared capability key?

reconciliation_rows_sample.label: Hold
reconciliation_rows_sample.notes: Semantic ENV1.Hold confirmed in UI (Hold time for envelope), but NO corresponding target in targets.py. Gap identified. Target GAP: Env1.Hold and Env2-4.Hold all missing.

reconciliation_rows_sample.label: Signal Balance (Modulation Route)
reconciliation_rows_sample.notes: MATRIX routing configuration. One semantic (the concept of a modulation route) maps to multiple targets (Curve, Bipolar, AuxSource, etc., representing different route properties).

reconciliation_rows_sample.label: Preset Load (Single-Click)
reconciliation_rows_sample.notes: Semantic: clicking a preset row loads it into Serum's engine state (atomic operation). No target in current targets.py; this is a structural/resource operation, not a parameter mutation.

phase_2_next_steps: PHASE 2 Complete: Extract frozen semantic vocabulary from SERUM2_SEMANTIC_INVENTORY.json (all 559+ records with full metadata)
Extract existing target vocabulary from serum2/compiler/targets.py and other project sources
Normalize both vocabularies into canonical forms (remove VST3 indices, establish semantic_id ↔ target_id bijection)
Build complete bidirectional reconciliation matrix (all rows, not just sample)
Phase 3: Analyze gaps (orphan targets, semantics with no targets, ambiguous mappings)
Phase 4: Derive representation families from behavioral properties, NOT VST3 naming
Phase 5: Select minimum set of deep experiments per family to prove operation semantics before implementation

critical_constraints.no_ui_probing: Phase 2 is reconciliation only. No Serum UI discovery or re-verification.
critical_constraints.frozen_inventory_authority: SERUM2_SEMANTIC_INVENTORY.json is the sole authority for what semantics exist.
critical_constraints.existing_targets_authority: serum2/compiler/targets.py is the sole authority for what targets are currently defined.
critical_constraints.no_assumptions: Do not assume VST3 parameter count matches semantic control count.
critical_constraints.bidirectional_validation: Must catch gaps in both directions: semantics with no targets AND orphan targets with no semantic.
critical_constraints.family_derivation_from_behavior: Representation families must be derived from read/write/persistence/automation behavior, NOT from VST3 naming conventions.
